title: Protocol for the generation and assessment of functional macrophages from mouse bone marrow cells
author: Scafidi, Lind-Holm Mogensen, et al.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and collect legs
steps.instruction: Perform cervical dislocation on a mouse (2–6 months old) following animal welfare guidelines and detach the posterior legs.

steps.title: Dissect posterior legs
steps.instruction: Execute the leg dissection as follows:

substeps.instruction: Attach mouse supine to a stable surface with needles or tape, leaving posterior legs free.
Disinfect skin and fur with 70 % ethanol.
Cut skin from foot pad toward abdominal cavity.
Detach skin from muscle using forceps.
Pull skin off foot with scissors.
Cut away most muscle and fat surrounding tibia, fibula and femur.
Position scissors on ilium‑femur joint, pull leg until detached; cut surrounding tissue if needed.
Store each leg at 4 °C in a tube containing 1× PBS.

steps.title: Ethanol and PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash each leg by submerging in 70 % ethanol for 5 s, then in 1× PBS for 5 s.

steps.title: Place legs in DMEM
steps.instruction: Keep the washed legs in a 10 cm petri dish containing complete DMEM.

steps.title: Isolate tibia and femur
steps.instruction: From each leg:

substeps.instruction: Cut the Achilles tendon and remove the foot with forceps.
Cut the patella ligament and surrounding muscle to detach femur from tibia and fibula.

steps.title: Remove muscle and fat
steps.instruction: Using cotton gauze, strip muscle and fat from the exposed bones; optionally break off the thin fibula to avoid loss of marrow cells.

steps.title: Flush bones to obtain marrow
steps.instruction: Flush bone cavities with complete DMEM:

substeps.instruction: Load a 10 mL syringe with complete DMEM and attach a 26G × 3/8″ needle.
Trim ~1 mm off each bone extremity (do not cut the whole extremity).
Insert needle into cavity, flush 5 mL medium, invert bone and flush another 5 mL.
Repeat for all tibiae and femora, collecting the effluent in a 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the flushed suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 × g for 7 min at 21 °C.

steps.title: Prepare NH4Cl lysis solution
steps.instruction: Make 0.17 M NH4Cl by diluting 200 µL of 1.7 M NH4Cl stock in 1800 µL sterile Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, add 2 mL of the 0.17 M NH4Cl solution to the pellet, and incubate 5 min at 21 °C.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge post‑lysis
steps.instruction: Dilute with 10 mL 1× PBS, centrifuge 7 min at 300 × g, 21 °C, then discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in complete DMEM
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL complete DMEM to the pellet.

steps.title: Count viable cells
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL cell suspension with 10 µL trypan blue, load into a Neubauer chamber, and count trypan‑blue‑negative cells at 10× magnification.

steps.title: Adjust concentration and add M‑CSF
steps.instruction: Dilute cells in complete DMEM to 5 × 10⁶ cells/mL and supplement with 40 ng/mL M‑CSF.

steps.title: Seed cells into 6‑well plates
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 mL of the cell suspension into each well of a 6‑well plate (add sterile uncoated coverslips beforehand if microscopy is planned).

steps.title: Prepare drug and control solutions
steps.instruction: Make drug solutions at twice the desired final concentration in complete DMEM:

substeps.instruction: Metformin 1 mM: dilute stock 1:10.
Metformin 2 mM: dilute stock 1:5.
Metformin 4 mM: dilute stock 1:2.5.
Control: dilute Milli‑Q water 1:2.5 in complete DMEM.

steps.title: Add drug solutions to wells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the appropriate drug solution to each well containing 1 mL cell suspension, achieving final concentrations of 0.5 mM, 1 mM or 2 mM metformin, or control.

steps.title: Incubate first 3 days
steps.instruction: Place plates in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator for 3 days.

steps.title: Refresh media with M‑CSF and drug
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL complete DMEM supplemented with 20 ng/mL M‑CSF and the appropriate metformin concentration:

substeps.instruction: For 0.5 mM final: dilute metformin stock 1:20.
For 1 mM final: dilute metformin stock 1:10.
For 2 mM final: dilute metformin stock 1:5.

steps.title: Incubate additional 4 days
steps.instruction: Continue incubation at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for another 4 days.

steps.title: Harvest BMDMs for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: At day 7, carefully remove supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑0.2% BSA buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 mL of 10 % BSA in 49 mL 1× PBS to obtain PBS with 0.2 % BSA.

steps.title: Wash cells and scrape
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL/well PBS‑0.2% BSA, remove supernatant, add another 2 mL PBS‑0.2% BSA, then scrape cells with a cell scraper and transfer to 15 mL tubes.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Spin 7 min at 300 × g, 4 °C; discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL PBS‑0.2% BSA.

steps.title: Count cells and aliquot
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL cell suspension with 10 µL trypan blue, count viable cells, then dispense 5 × 10⁵ cells into each 5 mL round‑bottom tube (one tube per condition).

steps.title: Set up compensation, FMO, unstained controls
steps.instruction: Prepare control tubes:

substeps.instruction: Compensation: treat 5 × 10⁵ cells with 5 % DMSO for 5 min at 37 °C (or use appropriate compensation beads).
FMO: allocate 5 × 10⁵ cells per tube, each lacking one antibody (six tubes total).
Unstained: allocate 5 × 10⁵ cells for a negative control.

steps.title: Wash cells before staining
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL PBS‑0.2% BSA to each tube, centrifuge 7 min at 300 × g, 4 °C, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare Fc block and live/dead dye
steps.instruction: Make TruStain FcX solution (0.5 µL FcX + 24.5 µL Brilliant Stain buffer per sample). Prepare LIVE/DEAD Near‑IR dye by resuspending dye with 50 µL DMSO, then diluting 1:10 in PBS.

steps.title: Incubate Fc block
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL TruStain FcX to each FMO, unstained, and analysis sample; add 25 µL PBS‑0.2% BSA to each compensation sample. Incubate 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Stain samples with antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of the appropriate antibody solution to each tube:

substeps.instruction: Compensation samples: single‑antibody solution (antibody + PBS‑0.2% BSA).
Live/Dead compensation: 25 µL Live/Dead Near‑IR only solution.
Unstained: 25 µL PBS‑0.2% BSA.
FMO: 25 µL FMO mix (all antibodies except the omitted one).
Analysis samples: 25 µL master antibody mix (as per recipe).

steps.title: Incubate staining
steps.instruction: Incubate all tubes for 30 min at 4 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Final washes and resuspend
steps.instruction: Wash each tube with 3 mL PBS‑0.2% BSA, centrifuge 7 min at 300 × g, 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells in 100 µL PBS‑0.2% BSA.

steps.title: Run flow cytometer and analyze
steps.instruction: Set up the NovoCyte Quanteon cytometer (NovoExpress software), acquire data, and analyze with FlowJo to obtain percentages of CD11b⁺ F4/80⁺ live cells and MFI of I‑Ab, H2Kb/H2Db, CD80, CD86.

steps.title: Prepare coverslips for microscopy
steps.instruction: Insert sterile glass coverslips into the 6‑well plate and seed 5 × 10⁶ cells per well (as done in steps 16‑18).

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: At day 7, gently remove supernatant, wash twice with 1× PBS, fix with 1 mL 4 % PFA for 10 min at 21 °C in a hood, discard PFA, wash twice with PBS, then permeabilize with PBS + 0.3 % Triton‑X‑100 for 10 min at 21 °C.

steps.title: Block and stain with phalloidin
steps.instruction: Wash twice with PBS + 0.1 % Triton‑X‑100 (5 min each), wash with PBS (5 min), block with PBS + 3 % BSA for 30 min at 21 °C, wash three times with PBS + 0.1 % Triton‑X‑100 (5 min each), prepare phalloidin working solution 1:300 in PBS + 1 % BSA, add 500 µL per well and incubate 1.5 h at 21 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Wash and label slides
steps.instruction: Wash three times with PBS + 0.1 % Triton‑X‑100 for 10 min each (protected from light), then label each glass slide with name, date, animal ID and staining type.

steps.title: Mount coverslips with DAPI
steps.instruction: Lift coverslips gently using a pipette tip and tweezers, mount on the labeled slide with Fluoromount medium containing DAPI, and seal the edges with nail‑polish.

steps.title: Dry and image slides
steps.instruction: Let slides dry for 20 min at 21 °C before imaging (or store at 4 °C protected from light for up to 1 week). Acquire images on a Nikon Eclipse confocal microscope.
